_comment: Pinned downloads for build.ps1. Every file is checked against its SHA-256; a mismatch stops the build. To move to a newer version, change url/file/sha256 together (take the checksum from the publisher's page, not from your own download) and test the installer again.

laragon._note: Laragon 6.0 is the last free release (7.x and later need a paid license). Only its manager, HeidiSQL and folder layout are used; its old Apache/PHP/MySQL are replaced by the components below.

php._note: Thread-safe build: Apache loads PHP as a module (php8apache2_4.dll). The backend needs PHP ^8.2 (composer.json, CodeIgniter 4.7).

vcredist._note: Visual C++ 2015-2026 runtime needed by Apache (VS18) and PHP (VS16). The aka.ms link always serves Microsoft's newest build, so this checksum changes when Microsoft updates it: run build.ps1 -AcceptNewVcRedist after checking the file's digital signature.

composer._note: Build time only (composer install --no-dev). Not installed on the server.

innoextract._note: Build time only: unpacks Laragon's installer without running it.

innosetup._note: Build time only: compiles BSU-Inventory.iss. Installed portably inside the build cache.
